description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the PortfolioCommandSourceWritePlatformService interface, providing functionalities for logging, approving, rejecting, and deleting command source entries related to portfolio operations in the Apache Fineract project. It manages command validation, permission checks, and interaction with repositories and other services for command processing.

classes.name: PortfolioCommandSourceWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PortfolioCommandSourceWritePlatformService interface, providing core command management functionalities for portfolio operations including logging commands, approval, rejection, and deletion with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: logCommandSource
methods.description: Logs a command source after validating user permissions and whether the change is an update of own details.

methods.name: approveEntry
methods.description: Approves a command entry pending approval, recreating command details and executing the approval process.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes a command entry after validation, when a maker-checker process is used.

methods.name: rejectEntry
methods.description: Rejects a command entry pending approval, marking it as rejected and saving the change.

methods.name: validateMakerCheckerTransaction
methods.description: Validates a command source for approval/rejection, checks user permissions, and enforces maker-checker rules.

methods.name: validateIsUpdateAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether system currently allows updates, based on scheduler job settings.
